item.title: How we saved 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1’s DNS cache
item.description: Five Rust-level memory optimizations to the DNS cache layout of Big Pineapple cut per-entry memory by 56%, freeing approximately 100 TB of memory across Cloudflare's fleet. (2 sources: cloudflare, hackernews)

item.title: How to Make Testing More Sustainable
item.description: By using a sustainable testing strategy, you can skip unnecessary tests, ensure failing fast and early, and only run tests affected by code changes. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Understanding useMemo and useCallback
item.description: What's the deal with these two hooks?! Lots of devs find them confusing, for a whole host of reasons. In this tutorial, we'll dig deep and understand what they do, why they're useful, and how to get the most out of them. (1 source: lobsters)
